claim: HA's Glances integration is a Local Polling integration that scrapes a Glances REST webserver (Web Server Mode, default port 61208) running on each monitored host, requiring Glances >= 2.3 with API v3 (v2 deprecated)
stance_target: ha-linux-agent's MQTT push + discovery model eliminates the per-host webserver + HA-side polling loop the incumbent Glances pattern requires
scope_conditions: Home Assistant Glances integration; Glances Web Server Mode
quoted_support: These sensors needs a running instance of glances in Web Server Mode on the host. The minimal supported version of glances is 2.3. ... Its IoT class is Local Polling.

claim: The HA Glances integration's sensor catalogue spans disk (per-mount use percent/absolute/size), per-physical-disk diskio read/write MB/s, memory and swap (percent + absolute), processor load, process counts (running/total/thread/sleeping), CPU percent, temperature (lm-sensors), Docker container counts and CPU/memory, RAID device counts, per-NIC rx/tx Mbps, per-GPU VRAM/processor/temperature/fan (py3nvml), and uptime — the de-facto scope of host monitoring in the HA ecosystem
stance_target: ha-linux-agent's sensor scope should match or exceed this catalogue to be a credible Glances replacement
scope_conditions: Home Assistant Glances integration sensor catalogue
quoted_support: For each detected disk (or mount point) the following sensors will be created: disk_use_percent ... diskio_read: Average rate of data read from the device in megabytes per second. ... For each detected GPU (video card) the following sensors will be created: memory_use ... Not all platforms can provide all metrics.

claim: Glances GPU sensors require the py3nvml Python package and CPU temperature requires installed/configured lm-sensors — the sensor surface is conditional on per-host Python package and kernel sensor configuration
stance_target: per-host dependency management is a real operational burden in the incumbent pattern; a static Rust agent with sysinfo/NVML bindings avoids it
scope_conditions: Home Assistant Glances integration; Linux hosts
quoted_support: For instance the GPU sensors require installing the py3nvml Python package, and the cpu temp sensor requires installing and configuring lmsensors in Ubuntu, and may not be available at all in other platforms.

claim: Support for the Glances API v2 is deprecated in favour of v3, and after upgrading the Glances server the HA integration must be reloaded to reconnect
stance_target: API-version coupling between host-side server and HA-side integration is an ongoing maintenance liability of the polling pattern
quoted_support: Support for Glances api version 2 is deprecated. It is recommended to upgrade your Glances server to version 3. Once upgraded, reload the integration to connect again.

claim: The Glances integration is maintained by a single integration owner (@engrbm87) and used by only 1.3% of active HA installations
stance_target: the incumbent's maintenance bus factor is thin; a purpose-built agent cannot count on upstream HA integration fixes
quoted_support: The Glances service was introduced in Home Assistant 0.7.3, and it's used by 1.3% of the active installations.
